review_rules: Do not promote fandom-standard mechanics into hard rules unless a source actually states them.
Metaphorical, poetic and technical-looking passages remain distinguishable evidence modes.
A recurring narrative pattern is not automatically a metaphysical law.
Separate gameplay soul mechanics from lore claims about soul ontology.
Record competing definitions of specialized terms instead of forcing one normalized definition.
